prompt:
Using the provided reference image as the layout and poster-style guide, create a new vertical 3:4 high-end travel design poster with the same two equal horizontal sections, but replace the Venetian canal subject with a Gothic twin-spired cathedral in Vienna at blue-hour night.

Top section: show a cinematic realistic travel photograph of the landmark front-on at dusk/night, with warm architectural lighting, dark tree silhouettes on both sides, deep blue sky, and a single glowing infinity-shaped light trail wrapping around the two spire tops.

Bottom section: transform the same landmark into a clean 3D isometric miniature diorama on a small square base, including exactly 2 tall illuminated spires, exactly 1 central cathedral building, exactly 6 surrounding trees, paved plaza tiles, warm doorway/window lights, and the same glowing infinity light trail around the spires. Keep the minimal cream editorial background and soft shadows like the reference poster.

Typography and graphic details: place a left-aligned title block in the lower half with the headline INFINITE FAITH, a thin horizontal divider line beneath it, and the small caption LIGHT CONNECTS\nWHAT TIME CANNOT.. Add a small bottom-left label No. 011\nEvening Series. Add a small compass icon on the right side of the lower half, and place bottom-right coordinates and city text 48.2196° N, 16.3656° E\nVIENNA. Use elegant serif typography, restrained spacing, premium museum-poster aesthetics, realistic-to-miniature transformation, no collage, no extra panels, no watermark.

promptZh:
以提供的参考图作为布局和海报风格指南，创作一张全新的 3:4 竖版高端旅行设计海报，保持相同的两个等分水平区域，但将威尼斯运河主体替换为 维也纳蓝色时刻的哥特式双塔大教堂。

顶部区域：展示一张该地标在黄昏/夜晚的电影级写实旅行摄影作品，包含温暖的建筑照明、两侧深色的树木剪影、深邃的蓝天，以及一条环绕两座塔尖的单条发光无限符号光轨。

底部区域：将同一地标转化为一个置于小型方形底座上的简洁 3D 等距微缩模型，包含 2 座高耸的照明塔尖、1 座中央大教堂建筑、6 棵周围树木、铺设好的广场地砖、温暖的门窗灯光，以及环绕塔尖的相同发光无限符号光轨。保持参考海报中简约的奶油色编辑背景和柔和阴影。

排版与图形细节：在下半部分放置一个左对齐的标题块，标题为 INFINITE FAITH，下方添加一条细水平分割线，并配以小字说明 LIGHT CONNECTS\nWHAT TIME CANNOT.。在左下角添加一个小标签 No. 011\nEvening Series。在下半部分的右侧放置一个小指南针图标，并在右下角放置坐标和城市文本 48.2196° N, 16.3656° E\nVIENNA。使用优雅的衬线字体，克制的间距，呈现博物馆级海报美学，实现从写实到微缩的转化，无拼贴，无额外面板，无水印。
